intervals.method: Clopper-Pearson exact interval: binomial tails summed with fractions, bounds found by bisection
intervals.model: each injection is an independent trial with one common detection rate, as if the injections were a random sample of the defects of interest; an assumption, not a description of how the set was built
intervals.regime_thresholds_source: PSY-002 (psy-002-governance-phase-transitions, pinned commit), section 'Signal 2: Health Score Velocity': regime thresholds on the resilience score R. Cited, not re-derived here; analyze.py checks that they are the cut points of the resilience metric policy.

step_tests.test: Fisher's exact test: two independent samples, both margins fixed; two-sided p = total probability of the tables no more probable than the observed one; one-sided p for the later cycle being higher

multiplicity.kind: computed: an exact enumeration, not a simulation
multiplicity.null_model: the catches recorded in all the cycles fell at random among all the trials, every arrangement equally likely; the tests of a family then run on the same table of counts

paired.kind: computed; the same injections are scored in every cycle, so the results are paired
paired.test: exact sign test on the injections whose result changed (the exact form of McNemar's test)

first_step_from_the_recorded_count.why: cycle 1 caught nothing, so the recorded 7 of cycle 2 are 7 gains and no loss

one_step_or_three.kind: computed from the recorded counts, cycles treated as independent samples
one_step_or_three.tests: homogeneity: Freeman-Halton exact test; trend: exact Cochran-Armitage test with scores 0, 1, 2, ...; both with the total number caught fixed

three_independent_cycles_under_one_fixed.rate_is: the pooled share of the three later cycles

trend_rule_on_independent_cycles_under_o.rate_is: the pooled share of the three later cycles

levels_as_units.why: Level scores are 0 or 1 in every cycle but one, so injections of one level were caught or missed together; counting levels scored 1.0 is the coarsest reading of how many independent results exist.

synthetic.kind: synthetic: imaginary cycles and injection sets, defined in scenarios.json

all_caught_on_the_reused_set.description: A fifth cycle that re-scores the same injections and records every one as caught.

held_out_sets.description: A fresh injection set written without knowledge of the fixes and scored once, compared with the last recorded cycle by a two-sided Fisher exact test. For each size, analyze.py finds the largest caught count that would still differ from the last cycle at the significance level.

worked_answers.kind: intermediate values shown in the lesson's exercise answers
